english.title: Make false statement for the purpose of obtaining / renewing / amending the registration of an exempt facility
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), for the purpose of

(A)_[obtaining]_
(B)_[renewing]_
(C)_[amending]_

the registration of an exempt facility under the Environmental Permitting (England and Wales) Regulations 2010, made a statement which you knew to be false or misleading in a material particular or recklessly made a statement which was false or misleading in a material particular, namely **(..SPECIFY THE FALSE STATEMENT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 38(4)(b)(iii) and 39(3) of the Environmental Permitting (England and Wales) Regulations 2010.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit or Prosecutions:
None.

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
